note: Drawn on the Mac (Apple M5 Max, Metal) on base dd83ac2f. Skin sphere: soft falloff with no hard terminator, no red on the white wall around it, no halo at its silhouette. Backlit fins: the 6 mm fin passes less and warmer light than the 2 mm one, red carrying furthest, as exp(-d / radius) per channel gives. Slab: the line's core goes cyan-white and red spreads several times wider than green, as the 5 mm and 1 mm paths give; the red halo is grainy with faint vertical bands, because 16 hash-rotated taps gather a 1 px line of light and no light is kept between frames. That grain is the method the issue names, not a fault in it.
